nodes.description: Privileged owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address staged by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
ERC20 token symbol, initialized to "LiberT" in the constructor.
ERC20 token name, initialized to "LiberT" in the constructor.
Token decimals, initialized to 0 in the constructor.
Fixed token supply set to 108000000 in the constructor; read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account balances; mutated by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, used by approve, transferFrom, allowance and approveAndCall.
FixedSupplyToken constructor: sets metadata, mints the full supply to owner (msg.sender) and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] computed with SafeMath.sub.
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to `to` after an unchecked addition guard; mutates balances and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from `from` to `to` decreasing balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender]; emits Transfer.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract; performs an untrusted external call before returning.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts; contract does not accept ETH.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract at tokenAddress, sending tokens to owner.
onlyOwner function staging newOwner for ownership transfer.
Transfers ownership to newOwner after require(msg.sender == newOwner) and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Checked addition library function: c = a + b with require(c >= a).
Checked subtraction library function: require(b <= a); c = a - b.
Checked multiplication library function with overflow require.
Checked division library function: require(b > 0); c = a / b.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, balance keys, allowance keys, authorization checks and forwarded to external contracts.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) with attacker-controlled target and data before the function returns.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an owner-supplied arbitrary contract.
Raw addition balances[to] + tokens in the transfer condition, an unchecked arithmetic guard.
Addition balances[to].add(tokens) in transferFrom is performed before any allowance/balance precondition check.
Authorization predicate require(msg.sender == owner) implementing the onlyOwner modifier.
Authorization predicate require(msg.sender == newOwner) governing ownership acceptance.
